infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: ALINE reads your calendar to coordinate hangouts with your friend groups.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: ALINE uses contacts to help you invite friends to your groups.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ALINE uses your location to suggest meetup spots that work for everyone.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: ALINE learns your routines (gym, university, home) so it can suggest the best times for your group to hang out.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ALINE accesses your photo library only if you choose to attach or set a photo.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ALINE uses your microphone so you can talk to your agent instead of typing.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: ALINE transcribes your speech so you can talk to your agent.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: ALINE reads your workouts and sleep so sessions you actually did count toward your goals, and your agent knows when you're asleep — without you logging anything.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: ALINE does not write to Apple Health.

plugins.photosPermission: ALINE uses your photo library so you can share event posters and flyers with your agent.
plugins.cameraPermission: ALINE uses the camera so you can snap event posters and add them to the town listing.

plugins.calendarPermission: ALINE coordinates hangouts using your calendar.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: ALINE learns your routines so it can suggest the best times for group hangouts.

plugins.microphonePermission: ALINE uses your microphone so you can talk to your agent instead of typing.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: ALINE transcribes your speech on-device so you can talk to your agent.

plugins.motionPermission: ALINE counts your steps to understand your day — when you're out walking versus at your desk — so it can plan around how you actually live.
